home.aboutTitle: A small studio in Beirut, working across the Mediterranean.
home.aboutText: Founded in 2012 by architect Nour Haddad, the atelier works on a limited number of projects each year — from mountain houses and city apartments to gardens on the coast. Every project starts with the site: its light, its views and the way people will move through it.

about.title: About
about.lead: Architecture is the art of arranging light. We design buildings, interiors and landscapes that feel inevitable — as if they had always belonged to their place.
bio: Nour Haddad studied architecture in Beirut and Barcelona before spending eight years in practices in Lisbon and Paris, working on housing, cultural buildings and the restoration of historic homes.

She founded Atelier Nour in 2012 with a simple ambition: to design fewer projects, more carefully. Today the studio is a team of six architects and designers working across Lebanon, Cyprus and the Gulf.

principles.title: Light first
principles.text: We study how the sun moves across a site before drawing a single wall. Openings, depths and materials are tuned to the light of each hour and season.

principles.title: Honest materials
principles.text: Stone, lime, timber and clay — local where possible, used plainly and chosen to age gracefully rather than stay new.

principles.title: Quiet proportion
principles.text: Calm comes from proportion, not decoration. We work with simple volumes, generous heights and carefully measured rhythms.
